title: Trifla Churna
description: Trifla Churna (Triphala Churna) is the foundational Ayurvedic blend of three fruits: Amalaki (Indian gooseberry), Bibhitaki (Beleric myrobalan), and Haritaki (chebulic myrobalan), each providing unique benefits. This classic formulation acts as a daily colon cleanser removing accumulated waste. Treats chronic constipation through gentle stimulation of intestinal peristalsis without harsh action. Detoxifies the liver by enhancing bile production and hepatic function. Lowers cholesterol through improved fat metabolism. Acts as a powerful cellular antioxidant protecting tissues from oxidative damage. This formulation is essential for long-term health maintenance.
dosage: Mixed with warm water strictly before bedtime
